articles.title: Russia strike kills 21 as Ukraine says it needs more missile interceptors
articles.description: The Russia defence ministry said it had struck logistics hubs and supply centres in Kyiv and the surrounding region.

articles.title: Ukrainian vegetable seller targeted in 'human safari' drone attack
articles.description: A video shows a Russian drone pursuing a street vendor in the Kherson region before exploding.

articles.title: Sunken Nazi warships emerge from the Danube as water levels drop to record lows
articles.description: Water levels in the river Danube have fallen so low due to this summer's dry weather in Europe that sunken Nazi warships are appearing into view.
